title: The gate that rejected every PR older than itself, and the delete that slipped past the fix
description: The G1 verdict driver (#4514) fell back when the base lacked the gate configs but not when the head did, so pre-gate branches failed rc=2 on FileNotFoundError. Steps 2 and 4 now skip only when the head also lacks the gate script; a missing config on a gate-carrying head fails as a deletion, and step 3 still judges the tree on the floor.
